content.name: Incendiary Cloud
entries: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is {@quickref Vision and Light|SRD51|2||heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

When the cloud appears, each creature in it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 10d8} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
The cloud moves 10 feet directly away from you in a direction that you choose at the start of each of your turns.

content.name: Incendiary Cloud
entries: A swirling cloud of embers and smoke fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} centered on a point within range. The cloud's area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52}. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (like that created by {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52}) disperses it.

When the cloud appears, each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d8} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} moves into its space and when it enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
The cloud moves 10 feet away from you in a direction you choose at the start of each of your turns.
